data.display_address: Oceana Pacific, Oceana, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
Experience true resort-style living in this exceptional 3-bedroom apartment at Oceana Pacific, Palm Jumeirah, featuring a rare and unique layout designed to maximize space, light, and breathtaking full ocean views.

This elegant residence offers a seamless indoor–outdoor lifestyle with floor-to-ceiling windows, a spacious open-plan living and dining area, and a large balcony overlooking the Arabian Gulf. Each bedroom is generously sized, with built-in wardrobes and en-suite bathrooms, ensuring comfort and privacy for both families and end-users seeking exclusivity.

The kitchen is fully equipped with high-quality finishes, perfectly integrated into the layout for both everyday living and entertaining. The master bedroom enjoys stunning sea views, creating a serene retreat inspired by five-star beachfront resorts.

Oceana Pacific is one of Palm Jumeirah’s most sought-after beachfront communities, offering residents:

Private beach access
Infinity swimming pools
State-of-the-art gym
Beachfront restaurants & cafés
24/7 security and concierge services

Key Features

3 Bedrooms | En-suite
Unique & spacious layout
Panoramic ocean views
Large balcony
Direct beach access
Resort-style amenities
Prime Palm Jumeirah location

Located moments away from Nakheel Mall, West Beach, Atlantis, and Sheikh Zayed Road, this property combines luxury, lifestyle, and long-term investment value.
